name: Separation of duties
summary: The building and reviewing agents are separate, and the loop opens pull requests but doesn't merge while auto_merge is off, its default.
setup: Keep auto_merge off, or require approval from someone other than the author in a branch ruleset that applies to admins before turning it on.

name: Literacy training and awareness
summary: Orientation and the exercises teach the rules, and orientation offers to record who went through it in the company record.
setup: Run /orientation for each person and keep the Onboarding table in company/COMPANY.md.

name: Protection of audit information
summary: Each usage-log line carries the hash of the one before it, the guard refuses agent writes to the logs, and the monthly review checks the chain.
setup: Forward the usage log and the loop's logs to a store no user or agent can edit, and run the monthly log review.

name: External system services
summary: An approved-tools table records each AI tool's plan and the date it was checked, and the setup check warns about any MCP server it doesn't list.

name: Prompt injection
summary: Reviewers read text as data and the evals plant instructions to prove it, but no model-based agent can be made immune.
